map.：厚 2.0 mm、面积 20 ft²：厚度属头层常规，面积属中皮，综合定级“头: : At 2.0 mm thick and 20 ft², the thickness is regular top grain and the area is medium hide, so the combined grade is "regular top grain medium hide", suitable for bags and uppers. At 0.6 mm thick and 30 ft², the thickness <0.8 is graded as split leather and the area as large hide, so the combined grade is "split large hide", suitable only for lining or decoration and not for load-bearing parts.
map.：厚度分级：≥3.5 mm 头层厚皮（鞋面、皮带等高强度用途）；1.2~3.5: : Thickness grading: ≥3.5 mm thick top grain (uppers, belts, other high-strength uses); 1.2~3.5 mm regular top grain (general fabric, bags, uppers); 0.8~1.2 mm thin top grain / split (garments, gloves, lining); <0.8 mm thin split (lining, decoration). Area grading: ≥25 ft² large hide (full large sheets, high utilization); 15~25 ft² medium hide; 8~15 ft² small hide (small parts); <8 ft² scrap hide (assembled from offcuts). Combined grade = layer (thickness ≥0.8 is top grain, otherwise split) + area grade.
